title: proxy-mod
description: This mod is made for users who want to use proxy to join multiplayer servers and stay private , using proxy mod You can join multiplayer servers with a private / alternate ip
body:
**Proxy-Mod**
(_ai was used to make this mod_)

## Usage for proxy mod

This Mod is used for people who want to not show their own [IP address](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IP_address) to the server

This mod uses the ip and port **YOU** have provided In the mod , if not the provided with ip to the mod / Disabled the mod through its gui , your ip address will be shown .

The mod acts as a layer between user and server i.e instead of connecting from user to server it goes from user -> proxy server -> Minecraft server , which makes the minecraft server think the proxy server is the player joining the server

### Why socks 5

Minecraft uses a protocol that requires UDP (for things like "ping" and fast movement data) and TCP (for logging in and chat).

----> HTTP Proxies usally on provide TCP , which can make Minecraft lag or fail to connect.
(__and most of the providers provide SOCKS5__)

Authentication Support: SOCKS5 (most of the times) requires a username and password, the mod has fields for these.

Mod's GUI is in Multiplayer section and click on it shows the gui with feilds to input IP / Port and User / pass (if required)



This mod is made for privacy reasons make sure that the server you want to use this mod on allows usage of proxy/vpn .
